attention_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least one attention-only event seed and at least one official non-attention event seed

single_event_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with exactly one official non-attention seed, government_space_contract present, no customer_win, and defense_budget_theme

government_contract_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

defense_budget_same_theme_winner_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with a mature defense_budget_theme government_space_contract row whose 10d cash-relative PnL, same-theme replacement value, and direct event return are positive

alpha_hypothesis: Defense-budget same-theme winner Space trend signals below RS60 top-quintile may merit a conservative default-off risk top-up.

experiment_log_record.hypothesis: Within accepted Space defense-budget same-theme winners, trend signals that have not yet reached RS60 top-quintile status may represent earlier catalyst continuation and deserve a small default-off allocation top-up.
experiment_log_record.backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md fixed 3-window Space protocol using frozen Space augmented snapshots

gate_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: Risk allocation for Space defense-budget same-theme winner trend signals that are still below RS60 top-quintile.
2_prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260515-021 accepted a same-theme-winner defense-budget top-up.
exp-20260515-020 rejected a broad RS60 x price-extension overlap top-up.
exp-20260515-019 rejected Space theme-beta pool expansion.
No prior Space experiment found that isolates the accepted defense-budget same-theme winner cohort by early RS60 state.
gate_answers.3_single_causal_variable: extra scalar on accepted defense-budget same-theme winner signals only when rs60_top_quintile_state is false
gate_answers.4_success_criteria: Aggregate EV and PnL positive, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed windows, max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, trade count >= 50, adjusted cohort nonzero.

experiment_log_record.rejection_reason: Gate 4 failed: selected early-RS60 scalar did not improve enough fixed windows without regression.
experiment_log_record.next_evidence_needed: Avoid another nearby defense-budget scalar retry until new closed Space rows or a different production-visible catalyst-quality field exists.

production_impact.notes: Experiment-only monkey patch; no live policy promoted.

experiment_log_record.why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking remains data-limited, recent Space candidate-pool expansion failed, and this isolates one production-visible catalyst-quality allocation state instead.
